scoring_origin: root Architect ordinal judgments; not measured product scores
score_scale: 1 weak design support to 5 strong design support; no accuracy/latency interpretation
schedule: Each round sorts eligible entrants by losses then ID, rotates left round-1 modulo count, grants minimum-prior-byes entrant a bye if odd, pairs adjacent entrants, cycles S1..S5 by round+pair index. Third recorded loss eliminates. Ties: higher M then lexical ID.

entrants.name: Extend the existing small-experiment tournament
entrants.weakness: one-small-improvement execution and unwired service composition

entrants.name: One durable host-driven coding brain
entrants.strength: short control path and coherent session state
entrants.weakness: one session can mix target context, evaluation and long-lived learning unless separated
entrants.reversal: one trusted repository and short tasks

entrants.name: Minimal builder plus forge CI
entrants.strength: small builder interface and low orchestration burden
entrants.weakness: discovery, recovery, tenancy and learning require additional services
entrants.reversal: isolated issue repair with strong supplied tests

entrants.name: Full eight-role council after every work step
entrants.source: local role contracts / historical full-council alternative
entrants.weakness: repeated context and checks dominate small changes
entrants.reversal: one unusually ambiguous high-risk architecture decision

entrants.name: Durable outcome graph on the current kernel
entrants.strength: existing recovery plus explicit whole-mission work ownership
entrants.weakness: context/check economy and cross-tenant lessons still need integration

entrants.name: Temporal-centered service replacement
entrants.strength: durable distributed workflow and operational scaling
entrants.weakness: new infrastructure, migration and history ownership complexity

entrants.name: LangGraph-centered agent service
entrants.strength: graph checkpoints and explicit agent transitions
entrants.weakness: replace/bridge existing event and authority contracts

entrants.name: Distributed event-bus specialist services
entrants.strength: independent service scaling and replaceable execution
entrants.weakness: distributed consistency and operating cost before workload justifies it
entrants.reversal: many isolated repositories across multiple hosts

entrants.name: Blackboard and task-market specialists
entrants.source: internal architecture alternative; no external performance evidence
entrants.strength: opportunistic specialist assignment and broad exploration
entrants.weakness: bidding/deduplication overhead and ambiguous value attribution

entrants.name: Independent bot installed in every target repo
entrants.strength: local repository conventions and simple per-repo triggering
entrants.weakness: configuration drift, duplicated control plane and difficult learning separation
entrants.reversal: a small fleet with strict repo-specific automation

entrants.name: Endpoint training first, then model-centric autonomy
entrants.strength: concentrated curriculum and reusable learned behavior experiments
entrants.weakness: training does not itself supply reliable effects, PR delivery or production oracles
entrants.reversal: offline learning research with a fixed runtime

entrants.name: Parallel speculative builder swarm
entrants.source: EX03 isolated workers / internal speculative alternative
entrants.strength: independent implementation alternatives on uncertain problems
entrants.weakness: multiplied tokens, correlated failures and integration contention
entrants.reversal: rare high-value hard tasks with ample budget

hybrids.name: Minimal loop plus durable kernel
hybrids.reversal: few trusted repositories and repair-focused workloads

hybrids.name: Flexible packages plus tenant-scoped learning and domain adapters
hybrids.source: A05+A03; EX04/05/08/09 patterns; local caches and draft broker
hybrids.strength: whole-lifecycle coverage with selective execution and explicit data boundaries
hybrids.weakness: more boundary integration than H01; gains unmeasured
hybrids.reversal: the desired whole-OS and external-app lifecycle

hybrids.name: Distributed durable workers plus shared control service
hybrids.weakness: infrastructure and migration expense at current scale

hybrids.name: Roblox-specialized autonomous studio
hybrids.strength: deep domain runtime acceptance and focused curriculum
hybrids.weakness: general repository portability and whole-OS breadth
hybrids.reversal: a Roblox-only product with established Studio workers
